start: sudo service postgresql start || true && sudo service redis-server start || true

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && CURSOR_AGENT=1 npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173

terminals.name: celery
terminals.command: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && celery -A app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2
